segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, thanks for making time. I had 2:00 to 2:30 for us to walk through the renewal and the additional services seats you mentioned.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that's right. We have 42 active seats today, and we're adding the support operations team, so I think we need 18 more by September 1.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, so 60 total seats starting September 1. Your current term runs through January 31, and the current unit price is $74 per user per month. For the added 18, we'd prorate September through January.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. What does that put the invoice at?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: For the 18 added seats, September 1 through January 31 comes to $6,660 before tax. The renewal from February 1 to January 31 next year at 60 seats would be $53,280 annually, assuming the same package.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That matches what I expected. We don't need the premium reporting add-on. Just the standard dashboards and the onboarding session for the new team.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, standard dashboards are included. The one-time onboarding session is $1,200, and we can schedule it the week of August 26 if procurement is done by the 16th.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: The 28th would be best. We have a team meeting that morning, so afternoon Pacific time is ideal.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: I can hold August 28 at 1:00 Pacific. For contract terms, no change to the master agreement, just an order form for the added seats and then the renewal order form for February.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Please send both. Billing should go to ap@northlinecomponents.com, and the PO number for the seat add is PO-4187.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I'll send the order forms today with the prorated seat add, the $1,200 onboarding line, and the renewal pricing for 60 seats. Anything else you want called out?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, that's it. If you send it over today, I can route it for signature tomorrow.
